CustomField.description: Set by the form when the respondent clicks Email me a resume link. When it gets a value, the Form Submission trigger generates a random single-use token (Internal Unique Token) and the Send Resume Link flow emails it. Cleared when the link is used, when the submission is submitted, and by the scheduled Expire Resume Tokens flow after the configured window.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Stamped with the current datetime when the respondent clicks "Email me a resume link" in the stages overview. Triggers the Form_Submission trigger to generate Internal_Unique_Token__c and the Form_Submission_Send_Resume_Link flow to send the email. Cleared on consumption, on form submission, and on scheduled expiration.
CustomField.label: Send Resume Link
